name: Zenobia Wreck
excerpt: An iconic wreck with trucks on deck and abundant marine life.
description: The Zenobia was a Swedish Ro-Ro vessel, approximately 172 metres long, that sank on 7 June 1980 on its maiden voyage. It is considered one of the best wreck dives in the world. It remains on the seabed with trucks still on its deck. Divers can explore the exterior of the ship and the rich marine life around it.
location: Larnaca city and bay, near Mackenzie Beach, approximately 1.4 km (0.8 nautical miles) from shore.
difficulty: For Advanced Open Water and Deep Diver-certified divers, especially for deeper wreck exploration. Boat-diving experience is recommended.
access: Boat access only. Organised trips operate year-round from Larnaca Fishing Harbour.
tips: Water temperatures range from around 17°C in winter to 29°C in summer. A thermocline may occur during summer. Careful underwater route planning and air-consumption monitoring are required.
seo_title: Zenobia Wreck Dive, Larnaca Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: Dive the Zenobia, one of the world's top wreck dives, 1.4 km off Larnaca. 17–42 m, trucks on deck and rich marine life. Scuba diving in Cyprus with Net Divers.

name: Cricket Wreck
excerpt: A historic British gunboat that has become an artificial reef.
description: This is one of Cyprus’s distinctive historic dive sites. The vessel was a British gunboat built during the First World War. In 1947, it was anchored in Larnaca Bay/Xylofagou to be used as a training target by the British Air Force. During heavy seas, its moorings broke, it took on water and sank. It now lies upside down on the seabed, forming an artificial reef that supports abundant marine life.
location: East of Larnaca Bay, off the coast of Xylofagou, at Cape Pyla.
difficulty: For Advanced Open Water and Deep Diver-certified divers. Boat-diving experience is recommended.
tips: Water temperatures range from around 17°C in winter to 29°C in summer, and a thermocline may occur in summer. Check buoyancy and plan the underwater route carefully.
seo_title: Cricket Wreck Dive, Cape Pyla Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: Dive the Cricket, a historic British gunboat turned artificial reef off Xylofagou at Cape Pyla. 27–33 m wreck diving in Cyprus with Net Divers.

name: Nemesis Wreck
excerpt: A popular artificial reef near Protaras, rich in marine life.
description: One of the popular artificial reefs in the Protaras area. The vessel was a Soviet fishing trawler sunk by the Cypriot authorities in December 2013 to create a rich habitat. The 25-metre-long vessel stands upright on the sandy seabed, and its exterior supports abundant marine life.
difficulty: For Advanced Open Water-certified divers. Boat-diving experience is recommended.
tips: Water temperatures range from around 17°C in winter to 29°C in summer. Check buoyancy and plan the route. This dive is often combined with the Liberty Wreck.
seo_title: Nemesis Wreck Dive, Protaras Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: Dive the Nemesis III wreck off Protaras, a popular artificial reef full of marine life at 15–25 m. Scuba diving near Ayia Napa with Net Divers.

name: Liberty Wreck
excerpt: A merchant vessel sunk to create an artificial reef near Protaras.
description: One of the first and most popular artificial reefs in the Protaras area. The merchant vessel was sunk in May 2009 by Paralimni Municipality and the Department of Fisheries and Marine Research, creating a rich habitat. It is 37 metres long and 7 metres wide and stands upright on the sandy seabed. A cross was placed close to the wreck by priest Fedor Konyukhov to commemorate the completion of a research expedition related to Europe.
location: Famagusta District, offshore from Protaras, opposite the Agios Nikolaos area and near the beach of the Golden Bay Coast hotel, approximately 650 m from shore.
difficulty: For Advanced Open Water-certified divers. Boat-diving experience is recommended.
tips: Water temperatures range from around 17°C in winter to 29°C in summer. Check buoyancy and plan the route. This dive is often combined with the Nemesis Wreck.
seo_title: Liberty Wreck Dive, Protaras Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: Dive the Liberty, a merchant ship sunk as an artificial reef 650 m off Protaras. 15–25 m wreck diving near Ayia Napa, Cyprus, with Net Divers.

name: Green Bay Statues
excerpt: A popular, accessible dive site with classical Greek-style statues and marine life.
description: One of Cyprus’s most popular, recognisable and accessible dive sites, suitable for beginners and experienced divers. Artificial statues in a classical Greek style have been placed at a depth of around 10 m, creating an excellent setting for underwater photography. The area is known as Turtle Bay and is noted for schools of fish, including saddled seabream, trumpetfish, leerfish and salema.
location: Paralimni Municipality, south of Protaras, near Cape Greco.
difficulty: Suitable for beginners and certified Open Water divers and above.
tips: Water temperatures range from around 17°C in winter to 29°C in summer. Enjoy the dive with a buddy and camera equipment under the supervision of experienced instructors.
seo_title: Green Bay Statues Dive, Protaras Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: Shallow, easy dive among Greek-style statues at Green Bay, near Cape Greco and Protaras. Up to 10 m, ideal for beginners. Scuba diving Cyprus.

name: Green Bay Blue Holes
excerpt: Underwater arches and rock formations just beyond the main statue site.
description: A little farther offshore from the main Green Bay statue site are arches and rock formations. The site offers memorable views of sandy seabed, marine life and fascinating underwater formations.
location: Paralimni Municipality, south of Protaras, near Cape Greco.
difficulty: For certified Open Water divers and above.
tips: Water temperatures range from around 17°C in winter to 29°C in summer. This dive is often combined with Green Bay Statues.
seo_title: Green Bay Blue Holes Dive, Protaras | Net Divers
seo_description: Underwater arches and rock formations just past the Green Bay statues, near Cape Greco. Up to 18 m. Scuba diving in Cyprus with Net Divers.

name: Cyclops Cave
excerpt: A dramatic rocky seabed, Posidonia seagrass meadows and abundant marine life.
description: A popular dive site known for its rugged rocky seabed on one side and extensive Posidonia seagrass meadows on the other. A natural cave on the shore is said in mythology to have been the Cyclops’ lair. Marine life is abundant and the underwater scenery is captivating.
location: Paralimni Municipality, on the boundary between Protaras and Cape Greco National Forest Park, near the Cyclops nature trail and the Konnos area.
difficulty: For certified Open Water divers and above.
tips: Water temperatures range from around 17°C in winter to 29°C in summer, and a thermocline may occur. Take care on the steep rocky access path, which has natural steps. Check buoyancy, plan the route and monitor air consumption.
seo_title: Cyclops Cave Dive, Protaras Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: Dive Cyclops Cave between Protaras and Cape Greco: dramatic rocky seabed, Posidonia meadows and marine life from 1 m to 40+ m. Diving near Ayia Napa.

name: Cape Greco Chapel – Agioi Anargyroi
excerpt: A striking dive entry through a sea cave beneath the white chapel.
description: A scenic and popular dive site marked by a white chapel with a blue dome. The route passes beside the chapel and down carved stone steps leading to a sea cave. Entry into the water is made through the cave opening beside the sea.
location: Cape Greco National Forest Park, Paralimni Municipality, directly below the Chapel of Agioi Anargyroi.
difficulty: For certified Open Water divers and above.
tips: Water temperatures range from around 17°C in winter to 29°C in summer, and a thermocline may occur. The stone steps are steep. Waves or strong winds can make exiting difficult, so check the weather before diving. Check buoyancy, plan the route and monitor air consumption.
seo_title: Cape Greco Chapel Dive, Ayia Napa | Net Divers
seo_description: Enter through a sea cave beneath the Agioi Anargyroi chapel at Cape Greco, near Ayia Napa. 9–40+ m. One of the best dives in Cyprus.

name: Cape Greco Blue Holes
excerpt: A natural underwater opening leading into a large chamber with crystal-clear water.
description: This site is known for a dramatic entrance through a natural underwater opening in the roof of a rock formation. Divers enter through the opening at the top of the rock shelf and continue into a large underwater chamber that opens onto crystal-clear sea water.
location: Southern side of Cape Greco in the National Forest Park, between the sea caves and the Chapel of Agioi Anargyroi.
difficulty: For certified Open Water divers and above.
tips: Water temperatures range from around 17°C in winter to 29°C in summer. Access involves uneven, steep rocky ground. A dive torch is useful. Check buoyancy, plan the route and monitor air consumption.
seo_title: Cape Greco Blue Holes Dive, Ayia Napa | Net Divers
seo_description: Swim through a natural opening into a large underwater chamber with crystal-clear water at Cape Greco, near Ayia Napa. 6–16 m. Diving in Cyprus.

name: Cape Greco Canyon
excerpt: A narrow underwater canyon framed by steep cliffs and a dramatic shore entry.
description: This dive has a distinctive atmosphere thanks to the huge vertical cliffs and walls that form a narrow canyon above and below the water. Entry is from the top of a coastal rock using a specially installed ladder, followed by a large step into the clear sea to explore the underwater canyon.
location: Southern side of Cape Greco in the National Forest Park, beneath the peninsula’s steep cliffs.
tips: Access involves uneven, steep rocky ground. Check buoyancy, plan the underwater route carefully and monitor air consumption. Check weather conditions, particularly for exiting the water.
seo_title: Cape Greco Canyon Dive, Ayia Napa | Net Divers
seo_description: Dive a narrow underwater canyon below the cliffs of Cape Greco, near Ayia Napa, with a dramatic shore entry. 5–22 m. Scuba diving Cyprus.

name: The Pirate Cave
excerpt: An underwater entrance into a large air chamber with stalactites and blue-green light.
description: The Pirate Cave is distinctive because its entrance is below the water surface and leads into a large chamber above water level. Natural stalactites can be seen inside, and bats inhabit the ceiling. Sunlight filters through openings in the roof, creating striking blue-green colours.
location: Dhekelia area, Cape Pyla, between Larnaca and Ayia Napa.
depth: 5 m at the entrance and surrounding area, down to 15 m
difficulty: For certified Open Water divers and above. Boat-diving experience is recommended.
tips: Water temperatures range from around 17°C in winter to 29°C in summer. A dive torch is useful. Check buoyancy, plan the route carefully and monitor air consumption.
seo_title: Pirate Cave Dive, Cape Pyla Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: Dive into the Pirate Cave at Cape Pyla, between Larnaca and Ayia Napa: an air chamber with stalactites and blue-green light. 5–15 m. Diving Cyprus.

name: The Watchtower – Xylofagou
excerpt: An accessible shore dive with sandy seabed, rocky reef and Posidonia meadows.
description: This site is easy to access from shore and is suitable for both beginners and experienced divers. It offers a mix of sandy seabed, marine life, rocky reef, underwater walls and Posidonia seagrass meadows.
location: Xylofagou area, Cape Pyla, between Larnaca and Ayia Napa, beside Xylofagou’s small harbour and near the Romantzo restaurant.
difficulty: Suitable for beginners and certified Open Water divers and above.
tips: Water temperatures range from around 17°C in winter to 29°C in summer. Check buoyancy, plan the route and monitor air consumption. Watch for boat traffic: the site is next to a fishing shelter, so always use a dive buoy.
seo_title: Xylofagou Watchtower Shore Dive, Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: Easy shore dive by Xylofagou harbour at Cape Pyla: sandy seabed, rocky reef and Posidonia meadows, up to 18 m. Between Larnaca and Ayia Napa.

name: Jubilee Shoals
excerpt: A dramatic deep reef with a steep wall and aircraft wreckage.
description: The top of the reef lies at 17 m, after which the seabed drops steeply like a vertical cliff to depths beyond 60 m. At around 37 m, remains of the wings of a British English Electric Canberra aircraft, which sank there in 1954, can be found. The reef supports abundant marine life at various depths.
location: Limassol District, Avdimou or Pissouri Bay, approximately 3–3.5 km offshore, opposite the rocky coast between Avdimou and Pissouri.
difficulty: For Advanced Open Water and Deep Diver-certified divers, especially for deeper exploration. Boat-diving experience is recommended.
tips: Water temperatures range from around 17°C in winter to 29°C in summer, and a thermocline may occur. Good buoyancy control, careful underwater route planning and air-consumption monitoring are required.
seo_title: Jubilee Shoals Dive, Limassol Cyprus | Net Divers
seo_description: Dive Jubilee Shoals off Pissouri and Avdimou, Limassol: a dramatic deep reef wall with aircraft wreckage, 17–60+ m. Advanced scuba diving in Cyprus.

name: St. George’s Island, Akamas
excerpt: A vertical reef and rich marine life off the Akamas Peninsula.
description: This is considered one of the leading and most impressive dive sites on the Akamas Peninsula. On the island’s western side, a vertical rock wall begins at a reef top 2–5 m below the surface and drops steeply to 35–40 m. The reef supports abundant marine life at various depths.
location: Paphos District, northern side of the Akamas Peninsula, between Latchi and Fontana Amorosa Bay.
difficulty: For Advanced Open Water and Deep Diver-certified divers, especially for deeper exploration. Boat-diving experience is recommended.
tips: Water temperatures range from around 17°C in winter to 29°C in summer, and a thermocline may occur. Good buoyancy control, careful underwater route planning and air-consumption monitoring are required.
seo_title: St George's Island Dive, Latchi, Paphos | Net Divers
seo_description: Scuba diving in Paphos: dive St George's Island off Akamas, between Latchi and Fontana Amorosa. A vertical reef and rich marine life, 2–40 m.
